decisions.reason: As a visibly launched multi-item consumer-health range that fits the announced portfolio-broadening strategy, management is likely to continue backing it and treat any weak traction as temporary despite the later lack of website evidence.

This supplement is less prominently committed than A, but because it still builds on the established health-products offer, sunk launch costs and a tendency to justify prior choices support keeping it for longer.

For the generic blood-pressure medicine, regulatory, manufacturing, and market-entry investments are substantial, and the earlier Valsartan issue can be framed as an external and temporary quality event rather than a reason to abandon the product.

The OTC migraine tablet required a public launch and meaningful pharmaceutical development and approval effort, so management would be inclined to persist unless there were clearly persistent failures, which are not shown here.
